items.title: Cartier Is Laughing At Your Alleged Luxury Slowdown
items.why: Top-tier jewelry demand holding up suggests the affluent spending slowdown story is uneven across brands.
items.summary_ai: Commentary argues Cartier is not feeling a luxury slowdown, pushing back on broader market talk.
